query:
Virtual economy is an economic activity in which human beings participate in speculation and simply expect the price of goods (materials or goods) to rise, without involving any material transformation. Strictly speaking, all virtual economic activities are caused by transaction costs, information costs or information asymmetry. From the perspective of reducing transaction costs, information costs or asymmetric information, Virtual economic activities greatly promote their real activities and participate in value manufacturing.

The fundamental difference between virtual economy and real economy described in this paragraph is that no value manufacturing is involved.
